_help.dragHeight: How high a dragged die floats above the table, in die sizes.
_help.followSmoothing: How much the dragged die lags behind your finger, in seconds. 0 = glued to the finger.
_help.keepGrabOffset: 1 = the die keeps the spot you grabbed it by under your finger. 0 = it jumps so its centre is under your finger.
_help.snapBackSpeed: How fast a die glides back to its slot when a drop doesn't count. Higher = faster.
_help.zoneHighlight: How the rolling area shows that letting go will count: "tint" = the drop zone glows brighter, "outline" = a glowing frame around the drop zone.
_help.highlightColor: Colour of the drop-zone highlight (tint glow or outline).
_help.tintStrength: How bright the drop zone glows in "tint" mode. 0 = no glow.
_help.zoneOutlineWidth: Thickness of the glowing frame in "outline" mode (table units; a die is 0.8).
_help.zoneOutlineOpacity: How solid the glowing frame is in "outline" mode. 0 = invisible, 1 = solid.
_help.highlightFadeSpeed: How fast the highlight fades in and out. Higher = snappier.
_help.zonePadding: How far inside the rolling area's walls a die must be for a drop to count (table units). Bigger = you must drag further in.
_help.dropPadding: How far from the walls a dropped die is nudged, so its two new dice have room to split out (table units).
_help.pulseSpeed: How fast the draggable dice gently breathe (grow and shrink) to show you can pick them up.
_help.pulseAmount: How much the draggable dice breathe. 0 = still, 0.03 = subtle.
_help.ringSize: Size of the white ring under each draggable die, in die sizes.
_help.ringOpacity: How visible the white ring under a draggable die is. 0 = hidden, 1 = solid.
_help.ringSelectedOpacity: How visible the ring is under a die that's picked up.
_help.liftHeight: How far a selected die rises out of its slot (table units).
_help.liftSpeed: How fast a selected die rises and settles. Higher = snappier.
_help.shakeSeconds: How long the little 'no' shake lasts when you press a die you can't drag (at the 12-dice cap).
_help.shakeDistance: How far the 'no' shake moves the die side to side (table units).
_help.shakeSpeed: How fast the 'no' shake wiggles. Higher = buzzier.
_help.capDim: How dark the locked dice go at the 12-dice cap. 0 = normal look, 1 = dark grey.
_help.capToastSeconds: The 'Max 12 dice' message shows at most once in this many seconds, however often you tap.
_help.parkedHopSpeed: How fast a dropped die hops to its resting spot in the rolling area. Higher = quicker hop.
_help.parkedHopHeight: How high that hop goes, in die sizes.
_help.parkedGlow: How much a dropped (parked) die glows in its own colour. 0 = no glow.
